To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the life expectancy in Vancouver’s Downtown Eastside will decline to 56.9 for men and 66.8 for women if the low levels antiretrovial therapy use among HIV-infected injection drug users persist, but will increase to 60.8 for men and 73 for women if the use of antretroviral therapy among HIV-infected IDUs increases to 80%.

the level of antireretroviral therapy use in the Downtown East Side of Vancouver, British Colombia, Canada is very low and if it continues to be so, life expectancy in this community will soon be on par with many of world's least developed nations.

If the low levels of use of antiretoviral therapy persist, life expectancy among people who inject drugs in Vancouver's Downtown will be reduced to levels comparable with many of the least developed countries in the world.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the impact of the HIV epidemic and antiretrovirals use on the health status of injection drug users ( IDU ).
the potential impact of antiretrovirals on mortality and life expectancies among IDUs in the Downtown East Side of Vancouver, Canada.
the impact of the HIV epidemic on the health status of the Downtown East Side (DES) of Vancouver, BC.

the HIV epidemic is a major public health issue that requires a coordinated, multi-sectorial approach to prevention and control.
the use of antiviral medication is urgently required to avert a catastrophic decline in health status.
antiretrovials are a good thing for the health of the population.

the use of antiviral medication is urgently required in order to avert a health status decline in many inner city areas.
we have shown the importance of using the best available data in modelling the impact of antiretrovirals.
the use of antiviral medication is a key component of the HIV prevention and control efforts in the Downtown East Side.

if we do not increase access to antiretrovial therapy for IDU in the near future, then the health status in the Downtown East will soon be as bad as in some of the least developed countries in the world.
